I am sure tons of us have had GPU sag issues. My MSI R9 390 has only been in my machine since last July and it already shows tons of sag. After looking at every option available to me I decided to try the CoolerMaster option that can support two cards in Crossfire/SLI found here (http://www.cmstore-usa.com/masteraccessory-universal-vga-holder-for-all-size-tower-chassis/)) I ordered from Amazon since I have credits from doing the Bing search crap so it was basically free. It comes as 5 parts, a base with magnetic feet, two posts you screw into that base, and the 2 supports with locks on them. Since I did not need the extra height and only have one card, I used just one post and support on mine. It was a little tricky to fit as I had to attach it to the cover while keeping out of the way of the fans but you can see that it helped straighten things out tremendously and should keep the card from bending any more. And if I do decide to go Crossfire with the next AMD card release I can put the other support on to help the cards out. I really wish I had put this in when I put the card in originally as it would not have bent at all more than likely.
